Floor 29 Byrd encounter

What was completed: Feed increased maximum HP from 90 to 93; Burning Blood restored HP after combat.

Strategy lesson: Against multiple Byrds, prioritize all-target hits to reduce Flight stacks while matching block to the displayed combined attack; use Hemokinesis only for immediate lethal at safe HP.

Ascension not recorded · completed

Floor 24 Gremlin Leader elite

What was completed: Gremlin Leader elite completed. The run reached 1 HP before a final Cleave killed the 5-HP Leader, causing its minions to flee. Burning Blood then restored HP to 10.

Strategy lesson: Proposed: do not recommend self-damage or an offensive setup when the post-action HP or unconfirmed enemy intent could make the line lethal; require exact enemy HP, Block, intent total, and card damage before calling a line lethal.

Act 2 floors 20-23

What was completed: Completed two normal combats and reached a Rest Site. Confirmed Snake Plant's Malleable behavior and that a 15-damage multi-hit turn required potion-assisted blocking while Frail was active.

Strategy lesson: Proposed: against multi-hit threats while Frail, calculate post-Frail Block before deciding whether to spend a temporary Dexterity potion.
